오늘 그 레시피를 공유합니다~!

🔴진~한 미역국 레시피
[불리는 물]
- 미역 20g
- 물 500ml
- 국간장 2숟가락 (30g)

[미역국 재료]
- 국거리용 소고기 200g
- 다진마늘 1숟가락 (13g)
- 참기름 2숟가락 (30g)
- 물 1.4L
- 국간장 2숟가락 (30g)
- 소금간
- 양파, 감자 취향것

[조리법]
1. 물에 국간장을 섞고 미역을 넣어 20분간 불린다.
2. 불린 미역은 물을 빼고 바락바락 주물러 진액을 낸다.
3. 냄비에 참기름과 소고기, 다진마늘을 넣고 중불로 약 1분 볶는다
4. 소고기의 핏기가 가시면 미역을 넣고 1분간 더 볶는다
5. 물을 1컵(200ml)을 넣고 5분간 끓여 맛을 우러낸 뒤 1컵(200ml)을 더 추가해 한번 더 우려낸다
6. 물 1L를 넣고 뚜껑을 덮고 중불로 30분간 끓인다
7. 국간장과 소금을 넣어 간을한다

- 참치액 2숟가락 (30g)
- 소금간
- 양파, 감자 취향것

[조리법]
1. 물에 소금을 섞고 미역을 넣어 20분간 불린다.
2. 불린 미역은 물을 빼고 바락바락 주물러 진액을 낸다.
3. 소주를 미역에 넣고 헹궈준다음 흐르는 물에 씻어낸다.
4. 물에 설탕을 넣고 섞은 뒤 소고기를 넣고 5분간 핏물을 뺀다
5. 냄비에 참기름과 미역을 넣고 중불로 약 1분 볶는다
6. 핏물을 뺀 소고기를 넣고 물을 1컵(200ml)을 넣고 5분간 끓여 맛을 우러낸 뒤 1컵(200ml)을 더 추가해 한번 더 우려낸다
7. 물 1L를 넣고 뚜껑을 덮고 중불로 30분간 끓인다
8. 참치액과 소금을 넣어 간을한다

snippet.description:
안녕하세요 첫째아들입니다!
오늘은 반찬가게 최고의 인기메뉴 '미역줄기볶음'을 준비했는데요
미역줄기볶음은 
1. 비린내
2. 짠맛
3. 식감
이 세가지만 잡으시면 맛있게 요리하실 수 있습니다!
가장 맛있게 만드는 방법 찾아왔으니 영상으로 확인해보세요~!

[재료]
 미역줄기 300g
- 양파 1/4개
- 당근 약간
- 미림 1컵
- 참기름 1스푼
- 참치액 1/2스푼
- 식용유 2스푼
- 다진마늘 1스푼
- 깨

# 조리법
1. 미역줄기를 물에 3~4번 씻어 소금을 씻어낸다
2. 물 1L를 끓이고 미림 1컵 넣고 미역줄기를 30초 데친다
3. 데친 미역을 차가운 물에 한번 헹군다
4. 당근과 양파를 채친다
5. 냄비에 식용유 2스푼, 다진마늘 넣고 중약불로 향을 뽑는다
6. 미역줄기를 넣고 센불로 1분 볶는다
7. 채썬 당근과 양파를 넣고 참치액 1/2스푼을 넣고 볶는다
8. 불을끄고 참기름과 깨를 둘러 마무리한다

snippet.description:
안녕하세요 첫째아들입니다!
오늘은 무의 시원한 맛을 확 살린 무생채를 준비했는데요,
평범한 메뉴지만 한끗 다른 비법이 있으니 꼭 챙겨가세요~!

[재료]
무 초록부분 600g
소금 1/2 숟가락 (5g)
멸치액젓 1숟가락 (15g)
고춧가루 1숟가락 (10g)
다진새우젓 1숟가락 (15g)
다진생강 1/3숟가락 (3g)
매실청 1숟가락 (15g)
미나리 50g
통깨

[조리법]
1. 무의 껍질을 살려 씻고 채썬다
2. 소금과 액젓으로 15분간 절인다
3. 미나리를 손질한다
4. 절인 무는 물기를 짜고 고춧가루, 새우젓, 생강, 매실청으로 간을 한다
5. 마지막으로 미나리를 버무려 마무리한다

en-US.title: Please remove everything from the raw radish salad and add 'this'! It becomes much tastier than a...
en-US.description:
Hello, this is the eldest son!

Today, I’ve prepared a raw radish salad that really brings out the refreshing taste of the radish. It may seem like a simple dish, but it has a secret tip that sets it apart, so be sure to check it out!

[Ingredients]

600g green part of radish

1/2 tablespoon salt (5g)

1 tablespoon anchovy fish sauce (15g)

1 tablespoon red pepper powder (10g)

1 tablespoon minced shrimp paste (15g)

1/3 tablespoon minced ginger (3g)

1 tablespoon plum extract (15g)

50g water parsley

Sesame seeds

[Cooking Method]

1. Wash the radish with the skin on and julienne it.

2. Marinate with salt and fish sauce for 15 minutes.

3. Prepare the water parsley.

4. Squeeze out the water from the marinated radish and season with red pepper powder, shrimp paste, ginger, and plum extract.

5. Finally, mix in the water parsley to finish.

snippet.description:
안녕하세요 첫째아들입니다!
오늘은 가장 많이 사랑을 받은 영상중 하나인 미역국을 준비했습니다~!
미역국도 한가지 방법이 있는게 아니라
맛을 내는 방법에 따라 크게 두가지로 나뉘는데요
오늘 그 레시피를 공유합니다~!

🔴진~한 미역국 레시피
[불리는 물]
- 미역 20g
- 물 500ml
- 국간장 2숟가락 (30g)

[미역국 재료]
- 국거리용 소고기 200g
- 다진마늘 1숟가락 (13g)
- 참기름 2숟가락 (30g)
- 물 1.4L
- 국간장 2숟가락 (30g)
- 소금간
- 양파, 감자 취향것

[조리법]
1. 물에 국간장을 섞고 미역을 넣어 20분간 불린다.
2. 불린 미역은 물을 빼고 바락바락 주물러 진액을 낸다.
3. 냄비에 참기름과 소고기, 다진마늘을 넣고 중불로 약 1분 볶는다
4. 소고기의 핏기가 가시면 미역을 넣고 1분간 더 볶는다
5. 물을 1컵(200ml)을 넣고 5분간 끓여 맛을 우러낸 뒤 1컵(200ml)을 더 추가해 한번 더 우려낸다
6. 물 1L를 넣고 뚜껑을 덮고 중불로 30분간 끓인다
7. 국간장과 소금을 넣어 간을한다

🔵깔끔하고 시원~한 미역국 레시피
[불리는 물]
- 미역 20g
- 물 500ml
- 소금 1숟가락 (15g)
- 소주 1/2컵 (100g)

[소고기 핏물빼는 물]
- 물 500ml
- 설탕 1숟가락(15g)
- 국거리용 소고기 200g

[미역국 재료]
- 참기름 2숟가락 (30g)
- 물 1.4L
- 참치액 2숟가락 (30g)
- 소금간
- 양파, 감자 취향것

[조리법]
1. 물에 소금을 섞고 미역을 넣어 20분간 불린다.
2. 불린 미역은 물을 빼고 바락바락 주물러 진액을 낸다.
3. 소주를 미역에 넣고 헹궈준다음 흐르는 물에 씻어낸다.
4. 물에 설탕을 넣고 섞은 뒤 소고기를 넣고 5분간 핏물을 뺀다
5. 냄비에 참기름과 미역을 넣고 중불로 약 1분 볶는다
6. 핏물을 뺀 소고기를 넣고 물을 1컵(200ml)을 넣고 5분간 끓여 맛을 우러낸 뒤 1컵(200ml)을 더 추가해 한번 더 우려낸다
7. 물 1L를 넣고 뚜껑을 덮고 중불로 30분간 끓인다
8. 참치액과 소금을 넣어 간을한다

en-US.description:
Hello, this is the First Son!

Today, I have prepared a recipe for seaweed soup, one of the most loved videos!

There isn't just one way to make seaweed soup; it is broadly divided into two types depending on how you enhance the flavor.

Today, I am sharing that recipe!

🔴 Rich Seaweed Soup Recipe

[Water for Soaking]

- Seaweed 20g

- Water 500ml

- Soy Sauce for Soup 2 tablespoons (30g)

[Ingredients for Seaweed Soup]

- Beef for soup 200g

- Minced garlic 1 tablespoon (13g)

- Sesame oil 2 tablespoons (30g)

- Water 1.4L

- Soy sauce for Soup 2 tablespoons (30g)

- Salt to taste

- Onion, potato (to taste)

[Cooking Method]

1. Mix the soy sauce for soup into the water, add the seaweed, and soak for 20 minutes.

2. Drain the water from the soaked seaweed and rub it vigorously to extract the liquid. 3. Add sesame oil, beef, and minced garlic to a pot and sauté over medium heat for about 1 minute.

4. Once the bloodiness of the beef is gone, add the seaweed and sauté for another minute.

5. Add 1 cup (200ml) of water and boil for 5 minutes to extract the flavor, then add another cup (200ml) and steep once more.

6. Add 1 liter of water, cover with a lid, and boil over medium heat for 30 minutes.

7. Season with soup soy sauce and salt.

🔵 Clean and Refreshing Seaweed Soup Recipe

[Water for Soaking]

- Seaweed 20g

- Water 500ml

- Salt 1 tablespoon (15g)

- Soju 1/2 cup (100g)

[Water for Removing Blood from Beef]

- Water 500ml

- Sugar 1 tablespoon (15g)

- Beef for Soup 200g

[Ingredients for Seaweed Soup]

- 2 tablespoons (30g) sesame oil

- 1.4L water

- 2 tablespoons (30g) tuna extract

- Salt

- Onion, potato (to taste)

[Cooking Method]

1. Mix salt into the water, add the seaweed, and soak for 20 minutes.

2. Drain the soaked seaweed and rub it vigorously to extract the liquid.

3. Add soju to the seaweed, rinse it, and then wash it under running water. 4. Add sugar to water and mix, then add the beef and let it soak for 5 minutes to remove the blood.

5. Add sesame oil and seaweed to a pot and sauté over medium heat for about 1 minute.

6. Add the beef (after removing the blood), add 1 cup (200ml) of water, and boil for 5 minutes to extract the flavor. Then, add another cup (200ml) of water and let it steep once more.

7. Add 1 liter of water, cover with a lid, and boil over medium heat for 30 minutes.

8. Season with tuna extract and salt.

en-US.title: The Secret to Juicy Korean Meatballs!
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Jangnamcook!
Lunar New Year is just around the corner, so I prepared a dish everyone loves: Donggeurangttaeng (Korean meat patties).
Check out my secret method for making them plump, bouncy, and bursting with juice right now!

[Ingredients]
Ground pork 600g
1/2 Onion (80g)
1/3 Carrot (100g)
Green onion (white part) 1/4 stalk (20g)
1 Spicy chili pepper
1/2 Block tofu (100g)
1 Tbsp Minced garlic
1 Tbsp Sesame oil
1 Tbsp Sesame seeds
1/2 Tbsp Salt
1/2 Tbsp Sugar
1 Tbsp Soy sauce
Plenty of black pepper
2 Tbsp Potato starch

[Egg Wash]
2 Eggs
1 Egg yolk

[Instructions]
1. Season the ground pork with salt, sugar, soy sauce, and pepper. Let it marinate for 30 minutes.
2. Finely chop the carrot, onion, green onion, chili pepper, and tofu.
3. Add the chopped vegetables, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to the meat. Throw the mixture down firmly to create a sticky, firm texture.
4. Coat with flour, dip in the egg wash, and pan-fry until golden brown.

snippet.description:
안녕하세요 첫째아들입니다!
오늘은 요즘같은날 뜨끈하게 먹기좋은 콩나물국
그리고 아삭함을 살린 콩나물무침을 준비했습니다!

콩나물국의 텁텁함을 최대한 없애 시원한 맛을 살리는 비법과
콩나물무침의 비린내를 잡고 맛을 살리는 특별한 소스도 같이 담았습니다!
오늘도 제 영상이 많은 분들께 도움이 됐으면 좋겠습니다~!

----
[콩나물국 레시피]
- 콩나물 300g
- 무 300g
- 청양고추 2~3개
- 마늘 5개
- 초벌물 1컵(200g)
- 물 1.2L
- 대파 20g
- 멸치액젓 1숟가락
- 소금 반숟가락
- 계란 1개

1. 냄비에 채썬 무와 소금, 멸치액젓, 물1컵을 넣고 센불로 졸인다
2. 물 1.2L를 추가하고 큼직히 썬 마늘과 청양고추를 넣고 끓인다
3. 물이 끓으면 콩나물을 넣고 뚜껑을 덮어 4분간 끓인다
4. 얇게썬 대파를 추가한다
5. 그릇에 콩나물국 한국자를 넣고 계란을 넣은 뒤 젓가락으로 찔러 전자렌지에 1분 돌린다

---
[콩나물무침 레시피]
- 콩나물 300g
- 물 반컵(100g)
- 들기름 1숟가락 (초벌용)
- 들기름 반숟가락(양념용)
- 소금간
- 미원 (취향것)
- 쪽파 1숟가락
- 깨 넉넉히
- 다진마늘 취향것
- 조미김 5장

1. 궁중팬에 콩나물과 물반컵, 들기름을 넣고 뚜껑을 덮어 찐다
2. 익은 콩나물은 채에 걸러 식혀주고 국물은 따로 빼둔다
3. 국물에 들기름과 소금, 미원을 취향것 넣고 마구 섞어 유장을 만든다
4. 식은 콩나물, 쪽파, 깨, 김을 유장에 넣고 버무린다

en-US.title: Restaurant-Style Bean Sprout Soup & Salad! The Secret to Refreshing Flavor
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Jangnamcook!
Today, I prepared a hot Bean Sprout Soup perfect for this weather, along with crunchy Seasoned Bean Sprouts!

I'll show you the secret to removing any heavy aftertaste from the soup for a truly refreshing flavor, plus a special sauce that eliminates the raw smell from the bean sprouts and brings out the taste!
I hope this video helps you out today!

----
[Bean Sprout Soup Recipe]
- Bean sprouts 300g
- Radish 300g
- Cheongyang peppers 2~3
- Garlic 5 cloves
- Water (for braising) 1 cup (200g)
- Water 1.2L
- Green onion 20g
- Anchovy fish sauce 1 tbsp
- Salt 0.5 tbsp
- Egg 1

1. In a pot, add sliced radish, salt, fish sauce, and 1 cup of water. Simmer on high heat.
2. Add 1.2L of water, roughly chopped garlic, and peppers, then bring to a boil.
3. Once boiling, add bean sprouts, cover, and boil for 4 minutes.
4. Add thinly sliced green onions.
5. Ladle soup into a bowl, add an egg, poke the yolk with chopsticks, and microwave for 1 minute.

---
[Seasoned Bean Sprouts Recipe]
- Bean sprouts 300g
- Water 0.5 cup (100g)
- Perilla oil 1 tbsp (for steaming)
- Perilla oil 0.5 tbsp (for seasoning)
- Salt to taste
- MSG (optional)
- Chopped green onion 1 tbsp
- Plenty of sesame seeds
- Minced garlic (optional)
- Seasoned seaweed 5 sheets

1. Place bean sprouts, 1/2 cup water, and perilla oil in a wok. Cover and steam.
2. Strain the cooked sprouts to cool and set the liquid aside.
3. Mix the reserved liquid with perilla oil, salt, and MSG to make the seasoning sauce.
4. Toss the cooled sprouts, green onions, sesame seeds, and seaweed with the sauce.

snippet.description:
#두부요리 #두부찌개 #두부강정 #두부부침 
안녕하세요 첫째아들입니다!
새해 첫 영상으로 자주사용하는 두부요리를 준비했습니다.(두부찌개, 두부부침, 양념장, 두부볶음)

[재료]

1. 연근 껍질을 벗긴 뒤 0.5cm 두께로 썬다.
2. 팔팔 끓는 식초물에 5분간 데친 후 물기를 뺀다.
3. 양념재료를 모두 섞는다.
4. 데친 연근을 양념장에 넣고 버무린 뒤 1시간 이상 절인다.
5. 냄비에 절인 연근과 생강, 물 2컵을 넣고 바짝 졸인다
6. 완전히 졸아들면 불을 끄고 들기름과 깨를 둘러 마무리한다.

en-US.description:
#Yeongeunjorim #BraisedLotusRoot #LotusRoot

Hello, this is your Jangnamcook!
Today, I'm going to show you a super easy way to make perfectly chewy braised lotus root!

[Ingredients]
2 lotus roots (400g)
2 cups water
2 slices of ginger (10g)
2 dried chili peppers (optional)
1 tbsp perilla oil
Sesame seeds

[For Blanching]
1L water
1 tbsp vinegar

[Sauce Ingredients]
3 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cooking oil
5 tbsp jocheong (can be substituted with corn syrup)


-----
[Directions]
1. Peel the lotus root and slice it into 0.5cm thick rounds.
2. Blanch in boiling vinegar water for 5 minutes, then drain well.
3. Mix all the sauce ingredients together.
4. Add the blanched lotus root to the sauce, toss to coat, and marinate for at least 1 hour.
5. In a pot, add the marinated lotus root, ginger, and 2 cups of water. Braise until the sauce has completely reduced.
6. Once fully reduced, turn off the heat. Finish with a drizzle of perilla oil and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

Use the five secret tips to make doenjang soup much more savory and neat!

2.5 tbsp soybean paste
Half of a small napa cabbage
1 white part of green onion
Half a onion
1 red chili pepper
Half tbsp minced garlic
Half tbsp soup soy sauce

20g dried anchovies (a handful)
5g dried kelp (1 sheet)
200g radish (a chunk)
2L water

1 tbsp raw soybean powder
1 tbsp perilla oil

4. Add the napa cabbage and onion, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
5. Add the remaining vegetables and soup soy sauce, then simmer for another 5 minutes.
6. Turn off the heat, drizzle with perilla oil, and finish.

en.title: Don’t Skip THIS Ingredient! Makes Your Chive Kimchi Twice as Refreshing & Super Addictive
en.description:
#ChiveKimchi #FreshChiveSalad

Hello, it’s your eldest son!  
It’s been way too long since I last said hi 😢  
I thought I’d be able to upload videos here and there while attending school, but keeping up with classes has been more than enough to handle, so I couldn’t get around to making videos.

Now that the first semester is over and I’ve got a short break, I finally had the chance to prepare a new video!

This time, we’re making *Chive Kimchi*!  
It’s tangy, sweet, and super tasty—even with just simple ingredients.

[Ingredients]  
- 1 bunch of chives (600g)  
- 6 spicy green chilies  
- 1/2 carrot (80g)  

*Seasoning ingredients*
- 1 onion  
- 1 small piece of ginger (5g)  
- 7 garlic cloves (20g)  
- 1/2 cup anchovy fish sauce (100g)  
- 1/3 cup plum syrup (65g)  
- 1 cup red pepper powder (80g)


[Instructions]
1. Wash the chives thoroughly and cut them into thirds.  
2. Julienne the chili peppers and carrot.  
3. Blend all the seasoning ingredients **except** the red pepper powder in a blender.  
4. Combine the blended seasoning, chili peppers, carrots, and red pepper powder. Let it soak for at least 10 minutes.  
5. Gently mix the seasoning with the chives, being careful not to crush the chives.  
6. Transfer the chive kimchi into a container, cover with plastic wrap or a disposable bag to keep out air, and store in the fridge.

Green Onion Kimchi (Easy Recipe!) 

Hi everyone, it's Jangnamcook! 
Today, I'm back with a recipe for "Green Onion Kimchi", 
a delicious side dish perfect for the Kimjang season! 
There are many ingredients that go well with green onions, 
but I think the best one is "anchovies"! 
This kimchi recipe uses both green onions and anchovies, and it's so delicious!

[Ingredients]
Green onions: 1 bunch (1kg)

[Sweet Rice Paste]
Water: 1 cup (200g)
Sweet rice flour: 1 tbsp (12g)
Anchovy powder: 1 tbsp (10g)

[Seasoning]
Anchovy fish sauce: 2/3 cup (130g)
Soy sauce: 1/3 cup (65g)
Coarse red pepper powder: 1/2 cup (100g)
Plum extract: 1/3 cup (65g)
Sugar: 1 tbsp (15g)
Garlic: 3 tbsp (30g)


[Instructions]
1. Clean and trim the green onions. Marinate them in anchovy fish sauce and soy sauce for 30 minutes.
2. Make the sweet rice paste with anchovy powder and let it cool quickly.
3. Once the sweet rice paste has cooled, add the seasoning ingredients and mix well. Bloom the red pepper powder.
4. Add the marinade from the green onions to the seasoning paste and mix well.
5. Mix the green onions and seasoning thoroughly.
6. Leave at room temperature for one day, then store in the refrigerator.

en.title: How to Make Gochujang Anchovies. Make stir fried anchovies twice as moist and crispy! / korean food
en.description:
#Anchovies #AnchovyStirFry #GochujangAnchovyStirFry

It's me Jangnamcook!
Today, I’m back with a special tip for making gochujang anchovy stir-fry!
When do you usually add syrup when making stir-fired anchovies?
Most people add it at the end after seasoning and stir-frying.
But after experimenting, I found that adding it "this way" gives the best texture and flavor!
Check out the video to see for yourself!

[Ingredients]
Anchovies (small, medium) 2 handfuls, 100g
Garlic: 6 cloves, 20g
Ginger: a little, 5g
Cheongyang pepper: 2
Red pepper: 1

[Secret Ingredients]
Honey (can be substituted with syrup, oligosaccharide, or rice syrup) 2 tablespoons
Sesame oil: 2 tablespoons

[Seasoning Ingredients]
Gochujang (Korean red chili paste): 1 tablespoon
Gochugaru (Korean red chili flakes): 1 tablespoon
Sugar: 1/2 tablespoon
Mirin: 2 tablespoons
Anchovy sauce: 1 tablespoon

[Optional Ingredients]
Plum extract: to your preference
Sesame seeds

[Cooking Steps]
1. Prepare the secret sauce.
2. Roast the anchovies in a dry pan.
3. Marinate the anchovies in the secret sauce.
4. Prepare the base ingredients and make the seasoning.
5. Stir-fry the garlic and ginger in oil, then add the seasoning and let it simmer.
6. Once the seasoning cools down a bit, add the marinated anchovies and mix well.
7. Add the peppers and sesame seeds, and adjust the taste with plum syrup to your preference.

1. 황태를 4~5cm 길이로 자르고 물에 빠르게 헹궈줍니다.
2. 물기를 짠 황태에 들기름 2숟가락을 넣고 버무려줍니다.

en.title: [galchi-jorim] This recipe will remove the fishy smell and boost the tenderness galchi-jorim
en.description:
This is Jangnamcook!

The weather's gotten chilly lately.
This the perfect time for galchi-jjigae!
Today, I'm showing you how to make tender galchi-jorim without any fishy smell!

[Ingredients]
1 hairtail (3-4 portions)
1/3 radish (400g)
1 sheet of kelp (10g)
1 handful dried shiitake mushrooms (15g)
1 stalk of green onion (100g)
2 green chili peppers and 2 red chili peppers
1/2 onion (120g)

[Seasoning Ingredients]
1/2 cup water (100g)
4 tbsp light soy sauce (60g)
3 tbsp coarse red pepper flakes (15g)
1 tbsp minced garlic (12g)
1/4 tbsp minced ginger (3g)
1 tbsp sugar or 2 tbsp corn syrup
1 tbsp perilla oil

[Process]
1. Cook the radish first.
2. Prepare the hairtail carefully to avoid any fishy smell.
3. Prepare the rest of the ingredients.
4. Make the seasoning.
5. Once the radish is about 80% cooked, remove the kelp, and add the remaining ingredients, hairtail, and the seasoning.
6. Cook quickly for about 10 minutes.
7. Finish off by adding 1 tbsp of perilla oil.

[Ingredients]
2 bowls of glutinous rice 500g (You can also use plain rice)
Malt 500g
Muslin cloth

1 cup of sugar 160g (2 cups for moderate sweetness)
1 piece of ginger 10g
*Half a spoonful of salt*
Pine nuts
Jujube

5. When 10 to 20 grains of rice float to the surface, take the sikhye out and transfer to a large pot
6. Add 3L of water with sugar, ginger, and salt, and boil for 10 minutes on high heat
7. Add pine nuts and jujube to your taste before drinking.

snippet.description:
#탕국 #추석요리 #명절음식 식

첫째아들입니다!
느끼한 명절음식에 속을 달래줄 개운한 탕국 만드는법 준비했습니다!
영상으로 바로 확인해보세요~!

[재료]
무 1/2개 500g
양지 1덩이 250g
두부 1모 300g
건다시마 1장 10g
참기름 1숟가락
국간장 1숟가락 15g
멸치액젓 1숟가락 15g (까나리, 참치액 대체가능해요)
소금간
물 1.5L
*청주 반컵 100g*


[조리과정]
1. 양지를 통으로 3분간 데쳐줍니다.
(자르지 않고 데쳐야 맛이 덜 빠져나가요)

2. 데친 양지를 찬물에 씻고 한입크기로 잘라줍니다
(결 반대방향으로 썰어야 부드러워요)

3. 무, 두부를 썰어줍니다
(큼직하게 썰어야 오래 끓여도 부서지지 않아요)

4. 참기름에 고기를 볶고 청주를 넣어줍니다
(청주를 넣으면 향이 훨씬 좋아집니다)

5. 물을 3번에 나눠 넣어준 다음 다시마를 넣고 30분간 끓여주세요. 떠오르는 거품은 걷어내줍니다
(물을 나눠넣으면 맛이 더 깊어져요)

6. 두부를 기름에 노릇하게 구워주세요
(두부에 고소한맛 생기고 오래끓여도 잘 부서지지 않아요)

This is my eldest son!
I've prepared a refreshing soup recipe to soothe your stomach during these greasy holiday meals!
Check out the video right now!

[Ingredients]
1/2 radish 500g
1 brisket 250g

Salt
1.5L water
*1/2 cup cheongju 100g*

[Cooking Instructions]
1. Blanch the brisket whole for 3 minutes. (Blanching without cutting will help preserve the flavor.)

2. Rinse the blanched brisket in cold water and cut into bite-sized pieces.
(Slice against the grain for tenderness.)

3. Slice the radish and tofu.
(Cut them into large pieces so they don't fall apart even after boiling for a long time.)

4. Fry the meat in sesame oil and add the cheongju (rice wine) (The cheongju enhances the flavor even more.)

5. Pour the water in three portions, then add the kelp and simmer for 30 minutes. Skim off any foam that rises.
(Adding water in portions will deepen the flavor.)

6. Fry the tofu in oil until golden brown.
(This will impart a nutty flavor to the tofu and prevent it from falling apart even after boiling for a long time.)

7. Remove the kelp, add the tofu, and season.
(Add only 1 spoon each of soy sauce and fish sauce.)

8. Wash the kelp used for the broth, chop it into bite-sized pieces, and use as a garnish.

en.description:
#Braised_short_ribs #Braised_short_beef_ribs#Chuseok_dish#Chuseok

Hello, this is Jangnamcook!
Looking at the comments on the last community post, you guys found making braised short ribs very difficult.
So today I prepared a recipe for tender, not salty braised short ribs!
See it for yourself in the video!


[Ingredient]
Short beef ribs 2kg
Radish 1/3개 250g
Carrot 1개 150g
Green and red Chilli pepper 3 each
Green onion stem 3개

[Seasoning]
1 cup of soy sauce 200g
2/3 cups of brown sugar 100g
Half a pear 230g
An onion 220g
10 garlic 50g
half a ginger 15g
Put a little bit of corn syrup, honey, or oligosaccharide
Pepper
*Finely grind it*

[shiitake mushroom water]
5 dry shiitake mushroom 
2L of water
 *Don't add all 2L at once and just add enough to submerge the ribs*


[Process]
1. Rather than removing the blood, just blanch the ribs for 5 minutes
(It makes richer flavor and better texture. Also, it removes gamey flavor)
2. Wash the blanched ribs, especially the bones and remove the fat and membrane with your hands
3. Put the seasoning ingredients in a blender and grind them. Soak the shiitake mushroom water for more than half a day
4. Add blanched ribs, seasoning, and shiitake mushroom water and boil them over medium heat. (The meat is more tender if you boil it slowly over medium heat.)
5. When it boils, lower the heat to medium-low and simmer for an hour
6. Prepare the sub-ingredients
7. Add the sub-ingredients to the ribs that have been boiled for an hour and boil for another 30 minutes
8.As a finishing touch, add corn syrup and pepper to enhance the visuals and scent.

en-US.title: I've cooked bibim guksu hundreds of times! Be sure to add "this" to your bibim guksu! / How to ma...
en-US.description:
Hello, this is my eldest son!
The rainy season is over and the intense heat has arrived!
So today, I've prepared a refreshing bibim guksu (Korean spicy noodles) to beat the heat.
Make this refreshing bibim guksu and enjoy it this weekend!

[Ingredients for 2 servings]
200g somen noodles (100g is the size of a 500 won coin when held in your hand)
1/2 cup fresh kimchi
1/2 cucumber

[Seasoning]
1 tablespoon gochujang (Korean chili paste)
2 tablespoons fine red pepper powder
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 tablespoons brewed vinegar
1 tablespoon minced garlic
1 tablespoon sugar
2 tablespoons plum extract

[Additional seasoning]
A generous amount of sesame oil or perilla oil
A generous amount of sesame seeds

*Key Points*
1. Don't use too much seasoning or sugar in the seasoning. It will greatly diminish the refreshing taste! 2. No need to add cold water three times when boiling noodles!
3. Try adding salt and vinegar when boiling noodles. This will make them chewy, like jjolmyeon (Korean noodles with spicy sauce).
4. Rinse the noodles in ice water right before mixing them with the seasoning. This will make them much chewier.

en.description:

The rainy season has came to an end and a huge heat wave has arrived!
So I've brought you a spicy noodle recipe that will blow the heat away.
Enjoy delicious spicy noodles this weekend!

Half a cup of aged kimchi
Half a cucumber

[Sauce]
A tablespoon of red chili paste
2 tablespoons of fine red pepper powder
2 tablespoons of soy sauce
A tablespoons of minced garlic
A tablespoon of sugar
2 tablespoons of plum extract

[After-seasoning]
Generous amount of sesame oil or perilla oil
Generous amount of sesame seeds


*Key point*

3. When boiling noodles, add salt and vinegar. The noodles' texture become like chewy noodles (jjolmyeon)!
4. Rinse the noodles in iced water just before mixing them in the sauce. It will maximize the texture.

snippet.description:
요즘 비가 많이 오는데 '전' 만한 요리가 없죠?
오늘은 특별한 재료 필요없이 "전을 2배 바삭바삭하게 만드는 비법" 준비했습니다!
이 방법만 아시면 집에 남는 채소로 얼마든지 응용 가능하니 맛있는 방법 놓치지 말고 챙겨가세요!

[주재료]
쪽파, 실파 1단 (170g)
오징어 1마리 (기호에 맞는 재료로 대체 가능)
청양고추 1개
홍고추 1개

[반죽물]
부침가루 1컵
물 2/3컵
소주 1/3컵

[양념장]
물 1숟가락
진간장 1숟가락
식초 1숟가락 (양조, 환만, 현미 식초)
설탕 반숟가락
양파, 고추 기호에 맞게


[핵심정리]
1. 반죽물 핵심 : 물과 소주를 섞어 사용해주세요 / 반죽물을 너무 많이 젓지 마세요 / 반죽물을 차갑게 만들어주세요
2. 해산물을 사용하실 때는 한번 데쳐 비린내와 물기를 잡아주세요
3. 전을 부치기 전 반드시 키친타올을 준비해주세요
4. 키친타올로 많이 제거되기 때문에 걱정마시고 기름을 반드시 넉넉히 넣어주세요. 
5. 남은 전은 한입크기로 썰어 냉장보관하시고 데워 드실 때는 에어프라이기에 120도 10분간 데워주세요.

en.description:

1 Green onion or Young Spring onion (170g)

1 Cheongyang pepper
1 Red pepper

[Batter]
A cup of flour mix
2/3 cup of water
1/3 cup of soju

[Dipping sauce]
1 spoon of water
1 spoon heavy soy sauce
1 spoon of vinegar (CJO, Hwanman, Brown Rice Vinegar)
Half a spoon of sugar
Onion, chili as much as you want


[Summary]
1. Batter : Use water and soju together / never stir it too much / make sure the batter is cold
2. Blanch the seafood to remove fishy smell and water
3. Prepare a paper towel before frying it
4. paper towel will absorb the oil, so use the oil generously.
5. Cut the remaining pancakes into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate them. Heat them in an air fryer at 120 degrees for 10 minutes if you want to eat them again.

Once you know this recipe, you can easily adapt it to any vegetables you have at home, so don't miss out on this delicious recipe!

[Main Ingredients]
1 bunch of chives and green onions (170g)
1 squid (substitute with your favorite ingredients)
1 Cheongyang pepper
1 red pepper

[Batter]
1 cup pancake mix
2/3 cup water
1/3 cup soju

[Seasoning]
1 tablespoon water
1 tablespoon soy sauce
1 tablespoon vinegar (brewed, Hwanman, brown rice vinegar)
1/2 tablespoon sugar
Onion and pepper to taste

[Key Points]
1. Batter: Mix the water and soju together. / Do not over-stir the batter. / Make sure the batter is cold.

3. Always have a paper towel handy before frying the pancakes.
4. Don't worry, the paper towel will remove most of the oil, so be sure to add plenty of oil.
5. Cut the remaining pancake into bite-sized pieces and store in the refrigerator. To reheat, heat in an air fryer at 120 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.

1 red pepper 10g

1 spoon minced garlic 10g
Plenty of sesame seeds
1 spoon perilla oil (for mixing)
A little perilla oil (for the side dish)

1 spoon soy sauce (15g)
0.5 spoon anchovy sauce
1 spoon plum extract

1. Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 1cm thick pieces. (If sliced ​​too thinly, they will wilt quickly. Slice lengthwise along the grain for a more even texture.)

4. I don't recommend using tuna extract for the seasoning.
(The smoky flavor is too strong, and it doesn't taste like vegetables.)

5. I recommend not adding red pepper powder.
(The rich flavor of the sesame oil and eggplant is greatly diminished by the harshness.)
